about.name: Bréval Le Floch
about.description1: I am a work-study student living in Nantes. From a young age, I have been very fascinated by the infinite possibilities of computers and new technologies.
about.description2: As I continue to learn and explore this ever-evolving universe, I am motivated by my passion for discovering new worlds and their new rules. Currently focused on front-end development while maintaining a deep interest in all aspects of computer science.

gaming.title: Digital Fascination
gaming.description: Passion for gaming and digital universes sparked the desire to create my own worlds
gaming.detailedDescription: My journey into technology began with an insatiable curiosity about digital worlds. Gaming wasn't just entertainment, it was a window into infinite possibilities. I spent countless hours exploring virtual universes, marveling at their complexity and dreaming of creating my own digital realms.

blender.title: 3D Discovery
blender.description: First steps into 3D modeling with Blender and Python coding in BGE
blender.detailedDescription: At 13, I discovered Blender and fell in love with 3D modeling. This wasn't just about creating pretty pictures, it was about bringing imagination to life. I dove deep into the Blender Game Engine, learning Python to create interactive experiences. This was my first real taste of programming, and it was intoxicating.

opensource.title: Open Source Explorer
opensource.description: Linux distributions, dual boot, and building PCs with friends
opensource.detailedDescription: Together with a friend, we tumbled down the rabbit hole of open-source software. We experimented with different Linux distributions, set up dual-boot systems, and breathed new life into old computers. We even started a computer club at school, teaching others about the power of open-source technology.

security.title: Network Hacker
security.description: Exploring network security, TCP/UDP, and gaining admin access
security.detailedDescription: Our curiosity led us to explore network security. We attempted to hack the school's network so often that we eventually gained administrator passwords! This wasn't malicious, it was pure curiosity about how networks function. We learned about TCP/UDP protocols, packet transmission, and network addressing through hands-on experimentation.

achievements.0: Gained admin access to school network

robot.title: Robot Builder
robot.description: Built a remote-controlled robot from scratch - components, soldering, coding
robot.detailedDescription: For my final college project, I decided to build a remote-controlled robot completely from scratch. I wanted to do everything myself: buy components, solder circuits, design the mechanics, and write the control software. This project taught me the beauty of bringing digital code into the physical world.

ai.title: Neural Network Pioneer
ai.description: Fascination with brain function led to creating neural networks from scratch
ai.detailedDescription: I became fascinated with understanding how the human brain works and naturally gravitated toward neural networks. I attempted to recreate neural networks from scratch, admittedly quite crude, but I didn't care! I was captivated by the idea of creating 3D neural structures, moving beyond traditional 2D layer architectures to mimic real brain structures.

social.title: Social App Developer
social.description: Attempted to build a social network app while learning databases
social.detailedDescription: I decided to tackle building a social network application, even though I had no idea how to use databases at the time! This ambitious project pushed me to learn about data persistence, user management, and application architecture. While the app never launched, the learning experience was invaluable.

school.title: Computer Science Mastery
school.description: Mastered databases, Docker, Kubernetes, and infrastructure security
school.detailedDescription: I arrived at computer science school with a burning desire to learn and master as many concepts as possible. I quickly filled my knowledge gaps in databases, particularly PostgreSQL, and dove deep into modern development practices. I mastered Docker, Kubernetes, automated deployments, and infrastructure security.

startups.title: Serial Entrepreneur
startups.description: ForMenu, My-Makeup, Forvoyez - multiple SaaS projects with friends
startups.detailedDescription: With my newfound knowledge, I launched into entrepreneurship with friends. We created a tutoring platform for evening student help, then ForMenu.fr for dematerialized restaurant menus, followed by My-Makeup.fr connecting professional makeup artists, and Forvoyez.com for automated meta-description generation. Each project taught us new technologies and business lessons.

current.title: Front-Ops Specialist
current.description: Specialized in frontend technologies and infrastructure management
current.detailedDescription: Today, I specialize in front-ops, the intersection of frontend technologies and infrastructure management. I love switching between different competencies, from crafting beautiful user interfaces to managing complex deployment pipelines. When I'm not coding on exciting projects, you'll find me playing indie games or exploring the latest technologies.

beginnings.title: First projects.
beginnings.description: Video games sparked my curiosity. At thirteen, Blender and Python gave me the tools to start making things of my own.

exploration.title: Learning by doing.
exploration.description: Linux, networks, a homemade robot, early neural networks. Small experiments, and a growing understanding of how things work.

building.title: Studies & entrepreneurship.
building.description: Computer science studies gave me a stronger foundation. Building ForMenu, My-Makeup and Forvoyez with friends taught me how to turn that knowledge into useful products.

today.title: Frontend & infrastructure.
today.description: My work sits between frontend development and infrastructure. I enjoy both the detail of an interface and the engineering that keeps it running.
